mapper.select: SELECT id, deck_id, ai_explanation_enabled_a, ai_explanation_enabled_b, ai_explanation_prompt_a, ai_explanation_prompt_b, ai_completion_enabled, ai_completion_prompt, updated_at FROM pw_deck_ai_settings WHERE deck_id = #{deckId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_deck_ai_settings ( deck_id, ai_explanation_enabled_a, ai_explanation_enabled_b, ai_explanation_prompt_a, ai_explanation_prompt_b, ai_completion_enabled, ai_completion_prompt, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{deckId}, #{aiExplanationEnabledA}, #{aiExplanationEnabledB}, #{aiExplanationPromptA}, #{aiExplanationPromptB}, #{aiCompletionEnabled}, #{aiCompletionPrompt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (deck_id) DO UPDATE SET ai_explanation_enabled_a = EXCLUDED.ai_explanation_enabled_a, ai_explanation_enabled_b = EXCLUDED.ai_explanation_enabled_b, ai_explanation_prompt_a = EXCLUDED.ai_explanation_prompt_a, ai_explanation_prompt_b = EXCLUDED.ai_explanation_prompt_b, ai_completion_enabled = EXCLUDED.ai_completion_enabled, ai_completion_prompt = EXCLUDED.ai_completion_prompt, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
